scripts.check: vp check && vp run typecheck && vp test && vp run build
scripts.cf:build:app: vp run --filter @saldo/web build && pnpm --filter @saldo/deployment exec cf build --mode app
scripts.cf:build:bridge: vp run --filter @saldo/bridge typecheck && pnpm --filter @saldo/deployment exec cf build --mode bridge
scripts.cf:check:app: vp run cf:build:app && pnpm --filter @saldo/deployment exec cf deploy --dry-run --prebuilt --mode app
scripts.cf:check:bridge: vp run cf:build:bridge && pnpm --filter @saldo/deployment exec cf deploy --dry-run --prebuilt --mode bridge --containers-rollout none
